665	    @staticmethod
666	    def _validated_dependencies(dependencies, known_ids):
667	        # Validate the dependency map: an object mapping normalized item ids
668	        # to arrays of normalized prerequisite ids, each following the
669	        # checklist single-line id rule. Keys, array entries, unknown ends,
670	        # self dependencies and cycles are all rejected; empty maps and empty
671	        # arrays mean "no prerequisites".
672	        if not isinstance(dependencies, dict):
673	            raise ValueError("dependencies must be a JSON object")
674	        normalized = {}
675	        seen_keys = set()
676	        for item_id, prerequisites in dependencies.items():
677	            if not isinstance(item_id, str) or not item_id.strip() or "\n" in item_id or "\r" in item_id:
678	                raise ValueError("dependency item id must be a non-empty single-line string")
679	            item_id = item_id.strip()
680	            # Case-sensitive, no trimming beyond the ends, no Unicode normalization.
681	            if item_id in seen_keys:
682	                raise ValueError("dependency item id must be unique")
683	            seen_keys.add(item_id)
684	            if not isinstance(prerequisites, list):
685	                raise ValueError("dependency prerequisites must be arrays of item ids")
686	            ordered, seen = [], set()
687	            for prerequisite in prerequisites:
688	                if (not isinstance(prerequisite, str) or not prerequisite.strip()
689	                        or "\n" in prerequisite or "\r" in prerequisite):
690	                    raise ValueError("dependency item id must be a non-empty single-line string")
691	                prerequisite = prerequisite.strip()
692	                # Case-sensitive, no trimming beyond the ends, no Unicode normalization.
693	                if prerequisite in seen:
694	                    raise ValueError("dependency prerequisite ids must be unique within one item")
695	                seen.add(prerequisite)
696	                ordered.append(prerequisite)
697	            normalized[item_id] = ordered
698	        for item_id, prerequisites in normalized.items():
699	            if item_id not in known_ids:
700	                raise ValueError("dependency item id must exist in the checklist")
701	            for prerequisite in prerequisites:
702	                if prerequisite not in known_ids:
703	                    raise ValueError("dependency prerequisite id must exist in the checklist")
704	                if prerequisite == item_id:
705	                    raise ValueError("dependencies must not contain a self dependency")
706	        # Reject every remaining cycle, including cycles over optional items:
707	        # resolve every id with an empty trail set.
708	        visiting = set()
709	        settled = set()
710	
711	        def visit(node):
712	            if node in settled:
713	                return
714	            if node in visiting:
715	                raise ValueError("dependencies must not contain a cycle")
716	            visiting.add(node)
717	            for prerequisite in normalized.get(node, ()):
718	                visit(prerequisite)
719	            visiting.remove(node)
720	            settled.add(node)
721	
722	        for item_id in normalized:
723	            visit(item_id)
724	        return normalized

730	            raise ValueError("version must have three nonnegative numeric components")
731	        items = self._validated_template(payload)

741	        # applicable to the same release; status is never inferred from texts.

761	        actual_by_id = {item["id"]: item for item in items}

841	    def _validated_rollback(self, rollback, release_version):
842	        # Validate the rollback plan: a strict {"targetVersion", "steps"}
843	        # object. targetVersion is null or a registered version numerically
844	        # smaller than the release; steps is a non-empty array of single-line
845	        # strings, stored trimmed with order and duplicates preserved.
846	        if not isinstance(rollback, dict):
847	            raise ValueError("rollback plan must be a JSON object")
848	        if set(rollback) != {"targetVersion", "steps"}:
849	            raise ValueError("rollback plan requires exactly targetVersion and steps")
850	        target_version = rollback["targetVersion"]
851	        if target_version is not None:
852	            if not isinstance(target_version, str) or not re.fullmatch(VERSION_PATTERN, target_version):
853	                raise ValueError("rollback targetVersion must be null or a valid version")
854	            records = self._read_store()
855	            if target_version not in records:
856	                raise ValueError("rollback targetVersion must be a registered release")
857	            if _version_order(target_version) >= _version_order(release_version):
858	                raise ValueError("rollback targetVersion must be smaller than the release version")
859	        steps = rollback["steps"]
860	        if not isinstance(steps, list) or not steps:
861	            raise ValueError("rollback steps must be a non-empty array of strings")
862	        normalized = []
863	        for step in steps:
864	            if not isinstance(step, str) or "\n" in step or "\r" in step or not step.strip():
865	                raise ValueError("rollback steps must be non-empty single-line strings")
866	            normalized.append(step.strip())
867	        return target_version, normalized

869	    def reconcile_checklist(self, version, checklist, template):
870	        # Read-only update of a same-version checklist against a revised
871	        # template: unchanged definitions keep their status, redefined items
872	        # reset to pending, new items are added and inapplicable items drop.
873	        if not isinstance(version, str) or not re.fullmatch(VERSION_PATTERN, version):
874	            raise ValueError("version must have three nonnegative numeric components")

878	        records = self._read_store()
879	        if version not in records:
880	            raise ValueError("unknown release")

882	        # Ids match case-sensitively after trimming, without Unicode normalization.
883	        previous = {item["id"]: item for item in items}
884	        reconciled, retained, reset, added = [], [], [], []
885	        for expected in selected:
886	            item_id = expected["id"]
887	            actual = previous.get(item_id)
888	            if actual is None:
889	                reconciled.append(dict(expected))
890	                added.append(item_id)
891	            elif actual["text"] != expected["text"] or actual["required"] != expected["required"]:
892	                # A redefined item takes the new definition and returns to pending.
893	                reconciled.append(dict(expected))

895	            else:

897	                                   "required": expected["required"], "status": actual["status"]})

900	        removed = [item["id"] for item in items if item["id"] not in selected_ids]

1191	    def _merge_classification(base_items, incoming_items, current_items):
1192	        # Whole-item three-way classification shared by the preview and its
1193	        # confirmation. merged maps every id to the kept item or None for a
1194	        # planned deletion; conflicts lists one original-detail entry per
1195	        # divergent id, and merged/conflict entries are detached copies.
1196	        base_by_id = {item["id"]: item for item in base_items}
1197	        incoming_by_id = {item["id"]: item for item in incoming_items}
1198	        current_by_id = {item["id"]: item for item in current_items}
1199	        merged, conflicts = {}, []
1200	        for item_id in base_by_id.keys() | incoming_by_id.keys() | current_by_id.keys():
1201	            base_item = base_by_id.get(item_id)
1202	            incoming_item = incoming_by_id.get(item_id)
1203	            current_item = current_by_id.get(item_id)
1204	            if incoming_item == base_item or current_item == incoming_item:
1205	                # The plan changes nothing, or the current side already
1206	                # matches the incoming side: keep the current side.
1207	                merged[item_id] = current_item
1208	            elif current_item == base_item:
1209	                # The current side matches the base: adopt the incoming side,
1210	                # including whole-item additions and deletions.
1211	                merged[item_id] = incoming_item
1212	            else:

class GenerateChecklistTests(unittest.TestCase):
    def setUp(self):
        self.temp = tempfile.TemporaryDirectory(dir=ROOT)
        self.addCleanup(self.temp.cleanup)
        self.path = Path(self.temp.name) / "releases.json"
        self.desk = ReleaseDesk(self.path)
        self.desk.add("1.2.0", [{"category": "Fixed", "text": "Retry empty exports"}])

    def template(self, **overrides):
        data = {
            "items": [
                {"id": "docs", "text": " Write notes ", "required": True},
                {"id": "fixed", "text": "Verify fix", "required": True, "categories": ["Fixed"]},
                {"id": "added", "text": "Announce feature", "required": False, "categories": ["Added"]},
            ],
        }
        data.update(overrides)
        return data

    def test_filters_by_release_categories(self):
        result = self.desk.generate_checklist("1.2.0", self.template())
        self.assertEqual(set(result), {"version", "items"})
        self.assertEqual(result["version"], "1.2.0")
        self.assertEqual(result["items"], [
            {"id": "docs", "text": "Write notes", "required": True, "status": "pending"},
            {"id": "fixed", "text": "Verify fix", "required": True, "status": "pending"},
        ])

    def test_result_feeds_checklist_and_check(self):
        generated = self.desk.generate_checklist("1.2.0", self.template())
        report = self.desk.checklist("1.2.0", generated)
        self.assertEqual(set(report), {"version", "ready", "done", "pending", "blocked"})
        self.assertFalse(report["ready"])
        self.assertEqual([item["id"] for item in report["pending"]], ["docs", "fixed"])

    def test_multi_category_item_kept_once_per_release(self):
        self.desk.add("2.0.0", [
            {"category": "Added", "text": "One"},
            {"category": "Added", "text": "Two"},
            {"category": "Fixed", "text": "Three"},
        ])
        template = {"items": [
            {"id": "both", "text": "Both", "required": True, "categories": ["Added", "Fixed"]},
            {"id": "changed", "text": "Changed only", "required": False, "categories": ["Changed"]},
        ]}
        result = self.desk.generate_checklist("2.0.0", template)
        self.assertEqual([item["id"] for item in result["items"]], ["both"])

    def test_extra_fields_and_template_status_ignored(self):
        template = {"version": "9.9.9", "extra": 1, "items": [
            {"id": "a", "text": " A ", "required": True, "status": "done", "other": [1]}]}
        result = self.desk.generate_checklist("1.2.0", template)
        self.assertEqual(result, {"version": "1.2.0", "items": [
            {"id": "a", "text": "A", "required": True, "status": "pending"}]})

    def test_invalid_version_and_unknown_release(self):
        for version in (None, 1, "v1", "1.0", "1.0.0.0", "01.0.0"):
            with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
                self.desk.generate_checklist(version, self.template())
        with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
            self.desk.generate_checklist("9.9.9", self.template())
        missing = ReleaseDesk(Path(self.temp.name) / "no-dir" / "releases.json")
        with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
            missing.generate_checklist("1.2.0", self.template())
        self.assertFalse(missing.path.parent.exists())

    def test_invalid_template_structures(self):
        invalid = [
            None, [], "x", 1,
            {"items": []}, {"items": {}}, {"items": None},
            {"items": [{"id": "a", "text": "A", "required": True}], "extra": []},
        ]
        for payload in invalid[:-1]:
            with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
                self.desk.generate_checklist("1.2.0", payload)
        # The extra field itself is fine; this one is valid.
        self.assertEqual(len(self.desk.generate_checklist("1.2.0", invalid[-1])["items"]), 1)

    def test_invalid_items(self):
        good = {"id": "a", "text": "A", "required": True}
        variants = [
            [], "x", None, 1,
            {**good, "id": None}, {**good, "id": 1}, {**good, "id": "  "},
            {**good, "id": "a\nb"}, {**good, "id": "a\rb"},
            {**good, "text": ""}, {**good, "text": "  "}, {**good, "text": 3}, {**good, "text": "x\ny"},
            {**good, "required": "yes"}, {**good, "required": 1}, {**good, "required": None},
            {**good, "categories": []}, {**good, "categories": "Fixed"},
            {**good, "categories": ["fixed"]}, {**good, "categories": ["Other"]},
            {**good, "categories": ["Fixed", "Fixed"]}, {**good, "categories": [1]},
            {**good, "categories": ["Added", "Added"]}, {**good, "categories": [["Fixed"]]},
        ]
        for item in variants:
            with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
                self.desk.generate_checklist("1.2.0", {"items": [item]})

            {"id": "ok", "text": "OK", "required": True},

            {"id": "SAME", "text": "Two", "required": False},

        self.path.write_bytes(raw)
        with self.assertRaises(ValueError):

        raw = b'{"1.2.0": [], "1.2.0": []}'

        self.assertEqual(self.path.stat().st_mtime_ns, mtime)

        template = Path(self.temp.name) / "template.json"

        result = subprocess.run(prefix + ["make-checklist", "1.2.0", str(template)], capture_output=True, text=True)
        self.assertEqual(result.returncode, 0, result.stderr)

        self.assertEqual(json.loads(result.stdout), {

        self.assertEqual(checked.returncode, 0, checked.stderr)

class CheckDependenciesTests(unittest.TestCase):
    def setUp(self):
        self.temp = tempfile.TemporaryDirectory(dir=ROOT)
        self.addCleanup(self.temp.cleanup)
        self.path = Path(self.temp.name) / "releases.json"
        self.desk = ReleaseDesk(self.path)
        self.desk.add("1.2.0", [{"category": "Added", "text": "One"}])

    def payload(self, *items):
        if not items:
            items = (
                {"id": "a", "text": "A", "required": True, "status": "done"},
                {"id": "b", "text": "B", "required": True, "status": "done"},
                {"id": "c", "text": "C", "required": False, "status": "pending"},
            )
        return {"version": "1.2.0", "items": list(items)}

    def test_no_dependencies_matches_check(self):
        for dependencies in ({}, {"a": [], "b": [], "c": []}):
            report = self.desk.check_dependencies("1.2.0", self.payload(), dependencies)
            self.assertEqual(set(report), {"version", "ready", "items"})
            self.assertTrue(report["ready"])
            self.assertEqual([item["id"] for item in report["items"]], ["a", "b", "c"])
            for item in report["items"]:
                self.assertEqual(set(item),
                                 {"id", "text", "required", "status", "effectiveStatus", "waiting"})
                self.assertEqual(item["effectiveStatus"], item["status"])
                self.assertEqual(item["waiting"], [])

    def test_chain_blocks_layer_by_layer_with_direct_only_waiting(self):
        # The spec example: A depends on B, B on C; A and B declare done while
        # C is pending. Both are blocked effectively, and A waits only on B.
        payload = self.payload()
        report = self.desk.check_dependencies("1.2.0", payload, {"a": ["b"], "b": ["c"]})
        effects = {item["id"]: item for item in report["items"]}
        self.assertFalse(report["ready"])
        self.assertEqual(effects["a"]["status"], "done")
        self.assertEqual(effects["a"]["effectiveStatus"], "blocked")
        self.assertEqual(effects["a"]["waiting"], ["b"])
        self.assertEqual(effects["b"]["effectiveStatus"], "blocked")
        self.assertEqual(effects["b"]["waiting"], ["c"])
        self.assertEqual(effects["c"]["effectiveStatus"], "pending")
        self.assertEqual(effects["c"]["waiting"], [])

    def test_undone_prerequisite_blocks_any_declared_status(self):
        payload = self.payload(
            {"id": "a", "text": "A", "required": True, "status": "pending"},
            {"id": "b", "text": "B", "required": True, "status": "blocked"},
            {"id": "c", "text": "C", "required": False, "status": "pending"},
        )
        report = self.desk.check_dependencies("1.2.0", payload, {"a": ["c"], "b": ["c"]})
        effects = {item["id"]: item["effectiveStatus"] for item in report["items"]}
        self.assertEqual(effects, {"a": "blocked", "b": "blocked", "c": "pending"})

    def test_waiting_lists_only_not_done_direct_prerequisites_in_array_order(self):
        payload = self.payload(
            {"id": "a", "text": "A", "required": True, "status": "done"},
            {"id": "b", "text": "B", "required": False, "status": "done"},
            {"id": "c", "text": "C", "required": False, "status": "pending"},
            {"id": "d", "text": "D", "required": False, "status": "blocked"},
        )
        deps = {"a": ["b", "c", "d"]}
        report = self.desk.check_dependencies("1.2.0", payload, deps)
        item_a = report["items"][0]
        # b is effectively done and drops out; waiting keeps only the not-done
        # direct prerequisites in dependency-array order, never transitive ones.
        self.assertEqual(item_a["waiting"], ["c", "d"])
        self.assertEqual(item_a["effectiveStatus"], "blocked")

    def test_optional_items_and_readiness(self):
        # A blocked optional item never decides readiness on its own...
        optional_blocked = self.payload(
            {"id": "a", "text": "A", "required": True, "status": "done"},
            {"id": "b", "text": "B", "required": False, "status": "pending"},
        )
        report = self.desk.check_dependencies("1.2.0", optional_blocked, {})
        self.assertTrue(report["ready"])
        # ...but an optional prerequisite still blocks a required dependent.
        report = self.desk.check_dependencies(
            "1.2.0", optional_blocked, {"a": ["b"]})
        self.assertFalse(report["ready"])
        self.assertEqual(report["items"][0]["effectiveStatus"], "blocked")
        # A required item declared done behind a chain of done optionals is ready.
        chain = self.payload(
            {"id": "a", "text": "A", "required": True, "status": "done"},
            {"id": "b", "text": "B", "required": False, "status": "done"},
            {"id": "c", "text": "C", "required": False, "status": "done"},
        )
        report = self.desk.check_dependencies("1.2.0", chain, {"a": ["b"], "b": ["c"]})
        self.assertTrue(report["ready"])

    def test_omitted_items_empty_arrays_and_normalized_fields(self):
        payload = self.payload(
            {"id": " a ", "text": " A ", "required": True, "status": "done"})
        report = self.desk.check_dependencies("1.2.0", payload, {})
        self.assertEqual(report["items"], [

def generate_checklist(self, version, payload):
        # Read-only checklist generated from a template: items are filtered by
        # the change categories actually registered for the release.
        if not isinstance(version, str) or not re.fullmatch(VERSION_PATTERN, version):
            raise ValueError("version must have three nonnegative numeric components")
        items = self._validated_template(payload)
        # The whole store is validated before the version is looked up.
        records = self._read_store()
        if version not in records:
            raise ValueError("unknown release")
        selected = self._applicable_template_items(items, records[version])
        return {"version": version, "items": selected}

    def generate_checklist_with_dependencies(self, version, payload, dependencies):
        # Read-only dependency-aware checklist generation: the template is
        # filtered by the release's change categories exactly like
        # generate_checklist, then every direct and indirect prerequisite of
        # the selected items is added even when its own categories do not
        # apply. The whole dependency graph is validated against the whole
        # template first, so edges of template items the filter would drop
        # still have to be legal and acyclic. Nothing is written and the
        # passed objects are never mutated.
        if not isinstance(version, str) or not re.fullmatch(VERSION_PATTERN, version):
            raise ValueError("version must have three nonnegative numeric components")
        items = self._validated_template(payload)
        # Every id in the dependency map, at either end, must reference a
        # template item: the complete map and the complete template are
        # validated, including items the category filter never selects.
        prerequisites = self._validated_dependencies(
            dependencies, {item["id"] for item in items})
        # The whole store is validated before the version is looked up.
        records = self._read_store()
        if version not in records:
            raise ValueError("unknown release")
        selected = self._applicable_template_items(items, records[version])
        selected_ids = {item["id"] for item in selected}
        # Close over every direct and indirect prerequisite of the selected
        # items; shared prerequisites are collected once. Only the member set
        # matters here: the final order always follows the template.
        closure = set(selected_ids)
        pending = list(selected_ids)
        while pending:
            node = pending.pop()
            for prerequisite in prerequisites.get(node, ()):
                if prerequisite not in closure:
                    closure.add(prerequisite)
                    pending.append(prerequisite)
        template_by_id = {item["id"]: item for item in items}
        # Final items keep template order: initially selected items stay in
        # their positions and prerequisites added solely for the closure slot
        # in at their template positions, even when their categories do not
        # apply. The selected dicts already carry the uniform pending item
        # shape; added prerequisites are rendered from their template entry.
        result_items, dependency_pairs = [], []
        for item in items:
            item_id = item["id"]
            if item_id not in closure:
                continue
            if item_id in selected_ids:
                result_items.append(dict(next(entry for entry in selected
                                              if entry["id"] == item_id)))
            else:
                result_items.append({"id": item_id, "text": item["text"],
                                     "required": item["required"], "status": "pending"})
            # Every final id gets a normalized array in template order;
            # omitted items and declared empty arrays both freeze to [].
            dependency_pairs.append((item_id, list(prerequisites.get(item_id, ()))))
        # includedPrerequisites lists, in template order, only the items
        # added solely because of a dependency edge.
        included_prerequisites = [item["id"] for item in items

class GenerateChecklistWithDependenciesTests(unittest.TestCase):
    def setUp(self):
        self.temp = tempfile.TemporaryDirectory(dir=ROOT)
        self.addCleanup(self.temp.cleanup)
        self.path = Path(self.temp.name) / "releases.json"
        self.desk = ReleaseDesk(self.path)
        self.desk.add("1.2.0", [{"category": "Fixed", "text": "Retry empty exports"}])

    def template(self):
        return {"items": [
            {"id": "docs", "text": " Write notes ", "required": True},
            {"id": "fixed", "text": "Verify fix", "required": True, "categories": ["Fixed"]},
            {"id": "added", "text": "Announce feature", "required": False, "categories": ["Added"]},
            {"id": "changed", "text": "Note a change", "required": False, "categories": ["Changed"]},
        ]}

    def generate(self, dependencies, template=None, version="1.2.0"):
        return self.desk.generate_checklist_with_dependencies(
            version, template or self.template(), dependencies)

    def test_empty_dependencies_matches_plain_generation(self):
        result = self.generate({})
        self.assertEqual(set(result), {"version", "items", "dependencies", "includedPrerequisites"})
        plain = self.desk.generate_checklist("1.2.0", self.template())
        self.assertEqual(result["version"], "1.2.0")
        self.assertEqual(result["items"], plain["items"])
        self.assertEqual(result["items"], [
            {"id": "docs", "text": "Write notes", "required": True, "status": "pending"},
            {"id": "fixed", "text": "Verify fix", "required": True, "status": "pending"},
        ])
        self.assertEqual(result["dependencies"], {"docs": [], "fixed": []})
        self.assertEqual(result["includedPrerequisites"], [])

    def test_inapplicable_prerequisites_are_added_in_template_order(self):
        result = self.generate({"fixed": ["added", "changed"]})
        self.assertEqual([item["id"] for item in result["items"]],
                         ["docs", "fixed", "added", "changed"])
        self.assertEqual(result["items"], [
            {"id": "docs", "text": "Write notes", "required": True, "status": "pending"},
            {"id": "fixed", "text": "Verify fix", "required": True, "status": "pending"},
            {"id": "added", "text": "Announce feature", "required": False, "status": "pending"},
            {"id": "changed", "text": "Note a change", "required": False, "status": "pending"},
        ])
        self.assertEqual(result["dependencies"], {
            "docs": [], "fixed": ["added", "changed"], "added": [], "changed": []})
        self.assertEqual(result["includedPrerequisites"], ["added", "changed"])

    def test_transitive_closure_adds_shared_prerequisite_once(self):
        # docs and fixed are both selected; both reach "added", which in turn
        # reaches "changed". Each added id appears once, in template order.
        result = self.generate({"fixed": ["added"], "added": ["changed"], "docs": ["added"]})
        self.assertEqual([item["id"] for item in result["items"]],
                         ["docs", "fixed", "added", "changed"])
        self.assertEqual(result["includedPrerequisites"], ["added", "changed"])
        self.assertEqual(result["dependencies"], {
            "docs": ["added"], "fixed": ["added"], "added": ["changed"], "changed": []})

    def test_unrelated_items_stay_excluded_even_with_edges(self):
        # Only selected/final ids appear in the dependency map: an inapplicable
        # item pointing at a selected one is neither added nor listed.
        result = self.generate({"changed": ["fixed"]})
        self.assertEqual([item["id"] for item in result["items"]], ["docs", "fixed"])
        self.assertEqual(result["dependencies"], {"docs": [], "fixed": []})
        self.assertEqual(result["includedPrerequisites"], [])

    def test_result_feeds_check_dependencies(self):
        result = self.generate({"fixed": ["added", "changed"], "added": ["changed"]})
        report = self.desk.check_dependencies("1.2.0", result, result["dependencies"])
        self.assertFalse(report["ready"])
        effects = {item["id"]: item["effectiveStatus"] for item in report["items"]}
        self.assertEqual(effects, {"docs": "pending", "fixed": "blocked",
                                   "added": "blocked", "changed": "pending"})
        self.assertEqual(report["items"][1]["waiting"], ["added", "changed"])

    def test_ids_normalized_and_array_order_kept(self):
        result = self.generate({" fixed ": ["  changed  ", "  added  "]})
        self.assertEqual([item["id"] for item in result["items"]],
                         ["docs", "fixed", "added", "changed"])
        self.assertEqual(result["dependencies"]["fixed"], ["changed", "added"])
        self.assertEqual(result["includedPrerequisites"], ["added", "changed"])

    def test_invalid_dependencies_structure(self):
        for dependencies in (None, [], "x", 1, {"docs": "fixed"}, {"added": None}):
            with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
                self.generate(dependencies)

    def test_full_graph_validated_including_unselected_items(self):
        # An unknown key on an item the filter would not select is rejected.
        with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
            self.generate({"added": ["ghost"]})
        with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
            self.generate({"ghost": ["docs"]})
        # A cycle over inapplicable items is rejected.
        with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
            self.generate({"added": ["changed"], "changed": ["added"]})
        # Self dependency, normalized duplicate keys, duplicate prerequisites.
        with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
            self.generate({"docs": ["docs"]})
        with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
            self.generate({"docs": [], " docs ": []})
        with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
            self.generate({"fixed": ["added", " added "]})
        for bad_id in (None, 1, "  ", "a\nb", "a\rb"):
            with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
                self.generate({"docs": [bad_id]})
            with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
                self.generate({bad_id: []})

    def test_invalid_template_version_store(self):
        for version in (None, 1, "v1", "1.0", "01.0.0"):
            with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
                self.generate({}, version=version)
        with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
            self.generate({}, version="9.9.9")
        with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
            self.generate({}, template={"items": []})
        missing = ReleaseDesk(Path(self.temp.name) / "no-dir" / "releases.json")
        with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
            missing.generate_checklist_with_dependencies("1.2.0", self.template(), {})
        self.assertFalse(missing.path.parent.exists())
        raw = b'{"1.2.0": [{"category": "Fixed", "text": "One"}], "9.9.9": []}'
        self.path.write_bytes(raw)
        with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
            self.generate({})

    def test_empty_selection_and_no_required_still_rejected(self):
        # Empty initial selection stays an error even with dependencies.
        only_added = {"items": [
            {"id": "a", "text": "A", "required": True, "categories": ["Added"]}]}
        with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
            self.generate({}, template=only_added)
        # An initial selection without required items is rejected even when a
        # transitive prerequisite happens to be required in the template.
        rescue = {"items": [
            {"id": "a", "text": "A", "required": False},
            {"id": "b", "text": "B", "required": False, "categories": ["Added"]},
            {"id": "c", "text": "C", "required": True, "categories": ["Changed"]},
        ]}
        with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
            self.generate({"a": ["b"], "b": ["c"]}, template=rescue)

    def test_readonly_and_detached(self):
        before, mtime = self.path.read_bytes(), self.path.stat().st_mtime_ns
        template, dependencies = self.template(), {"fixed": ["added"]}
        template_snapshot = json.loads(json.dumps(template))
        deps_snapshot = json.loads(json.dumps(dependencies))
        result = self.generate(dependencies, template)
        result["items"][0]["text"] = "mutated"
        result["items"].append({"id": "x"})
        result["dependencies"]["fixed"].append("docs")
        result["dependencies"]["new"] = ["x"]
        result["includedPrerequisites"].append("fixed")
        self.assertEqual(template, template_snapshot)
        self.assertEqual(dependencies, deps_snapshot)
        again = self.generate(dependencies, template)
        self.assertEqual([item["id"] for item in again["items"]], ["docs", "fixed", "added"])
        self.assertEqual(again["dependencies"]["fixed"], ["added"])
        self.assertEqual(again["includedPrerequisites"], ["added"])
        self.assertEqual(self.path.read_bytes(), before)
        self.assertEqual(self.path.stat().st_mtime_ns, mtime)

    def test_cli_with_dependencies(self):
        prefix = [sys.executable, str(ROOT / "release_desk.py"), "--store", str(self.path)]
        template = Path(self.temp.name) / "template.json"
        dependencies = Path(self.temp.name) / "dependencies.json"
        template.write_text(json.dumps(self.template()), encoding="utf-8")
        dependencies.write_text(json.dumps({"fixed": ["added", "changed"]}), encoding="utf-8")
        result = subprocess.run(prefix + ["make-checklist", "1.2.0", str(template),
                                          "--dependencies", str(dependencies)],
                                capture_output=True, text=True)
        self.assertEqual(result.returncode, 0, result.stderr)
        self.assertEqual(result.stdout.count("\n"), 1)
        parsed = json.loads(result.stdout)
        self.assertEqual(list(parsed), ["version", "items", "dependencies", "includedPrerequisites"])
        self.assertEqual([item["id"] for item in parsed["items"]],
                         ["docs", "fixed", "added", "changed"])
        self.assertEqual(parsed["includedPrerequisites"], ["added", "changed"])
        # The generated checklist plus the frozen map goes straight to check.
        generated = Path(self.temp.name) / "generated.json"
        generated.write_text(json.dumps({"version": parsed["version"], "items": parsed["items"]}),
                             encoding="utf-8")
        frozen = Path(self.temp.name) / "frozen.json"
        frozen.write_text(json.dumps(parsed["dependencies"]), encoding="utf-8")
        checked = subprocess.run(prefix + ["check-dependencies", "1.2.0",
                                           str(generated), str(frozen)],
                                 capture_output=True, text=True)
        self.assertEqual(checked.returncode, 0, checked.stderr)
        self.assertFalse(json.loads(checked.stdout)["ready"])

    def test_cli_without_option_keeps_original_shape(self):
        prefix = [sys.executable, str(ROOT / "release_desk.py"), "--store", str(self.path)]
        template = Path(self.temp.name) / "template.json"
        template.write_text(json.dumps(self.template()), encoding="utf-8")
        result = subprocess.run(prefix + ["make-checklist", "1.2.0", str(template)],
                                capture_output=True, text=True)
        self.assertEqual(result.returncode, 0, result.stderr)
        self.assertEqual(list(json.loads(result.stdout)), ["version", "items"])

    def test_cli_dependency_errors(self):
        prefix = [sys.executable, str(ROOT / "release_desk.py"), "--store", str(self.path)]
        before = self.path.read_bytes()
        template = Path(self.temp.name) / "template.json"
        dependencies = Path(self.temp.name) / "dependencies.json"
        template.write_text(json.dumps(self.template()), encoding="utf-8")
        cases = [
            "{not json",
            b"\xff\xfe",
            "[]",
            json.dumps({"added": ["ghost"]}),
            json.dumps({"added": ["changed"], "changed": ["added"]}),
            json.dumps({"docs": ["docs"]}),
            '{"docs": [], " docs ": []}',
            '{"docs": [], "docs": []}',
        ]
        for case in cases:
            if isinstance(case, bytes):
                dependencies.write_bytes(case)
            else:
                dependencies.write_text(case, encoding="utf-8")
            result = subprocess.run(prefix + ["make-checklist", "1.2.0", str(template),
                                              "--dependencies", str(dependencies)],
                                    capture_output=True, text=True)
            self.assertEqual(result.returncode, 2, case)
            self.assertEqual(set(json.loads(result.stdout)), {"error"})
        absent = subprocess.run(prefix + ["make-checklist", "1.2.0", str(template),
                                          "--dependencies", str(Path(self.temp.name) / "nope.json")],
                                capture_output=True, text=True)
        self.assertEqual(absent.returncode, 2)
        self.assertIn("error", json.loads(absent.stdout))
        self.assertEqual(self.path.read_bytes(), before)
        self.assertFalse((Path(self.temp.name) / "nope.json").exists())

Both ends must reference **template** items, and the whole dependency graph is validated against the whole template — including template items the category filter never selects — so an unknown reference, self dependency or cycle among inapplicable items still fails; the whole version store is validated the same way as `generate_checklist`, and a missing store is treated as empty and then reports the version as unknown.

+Generation first applies the existing category filter unchanged, then closes over every direct and indirect prerequisite of the selected items: a prerequisite whose own categories do not apply to the release is still added, each shared prerequisite is added only once, and template items no selected item reaches stay excluded even when they appear in the dependency object. An empty initial filter or an initial selection without any required item still raises `ValueError` exactly as in `generate_checklist`. The result holds only `version`, `items`, `dependencies` and `includedPrerequisites`. `items` keeps template order — initially selected items stay in their positions and prerequisites added solely for the closure slot in at their template positions — and each item carries only the standard four fields with a uniform `pending` status and the template's `required` value, so the output can be passed straight to `checklist` or `check_dependencies`. `dependencies` holds one normalized array per final id in template order: direct prerequisites keep their dependency-array order, and items with no declared dependencies output an empty array. `includedPrerequisites` lists, in template order, only the ids added solely because of a dependency edge; with an empty dependency object `items` is identical to plain generation and that array is empty. The returned result and its dependency map can be handed straight to the existing `check_dependencies`.

+An invalid or unknown version, an invalid store or template, a non-object dependency value, an illegal id, a normalized duplicate key or duplicate prerequisite, a non-array dependency value, an unknown reference at either end, a self dependency or any cycle raises `ValueError`, and read failures raise `OSError`; the CLI additionally rejects non-UTF-8 files, JSON syntax errors and repeated object keys at any level in either file, printing only a single-line `error` object with exit 2. A valid run prints the single-line result JSON with exit 0. Neither success nor failure modifies the passed objects, the input files or the store, or creates any file or directory, and mutating nested data in the returned result never reaches the passed inputs. All other public entry points keep their existing behavior.

`ReleaseDesk.audit_checklist(version, checklist, template)` is a read-only cross-check of a declared checklist against the template items applicable to the same release, and `python3 release_desk.py audit-checklist 1.2.0 checklist.json template.json` runs it on two UTF-8 JSON files using the same `--store` selection. Both inputs follow the existing checklist and template rules: the checklist version must equal the queried version, the template is filtered by the release's change categories exactly like `generate_checklist`, items the filter drops are still fully validated, and status is never inferred from change texts. Items are matched by their trimmed ids, case-sensitively and without Unicode normalization. The report holds only `version`, `ready`, `done`, `pending`, `blocked`, `missing`, `mismatched` and `unexpected`. The three status arrays are the same groups `checklist` would return, keeping every item and the input order within each group. `missing` lists applicable template items whose id has no checklist counterpart, each holding only `id`, `text`, `required` and a uniform `pending` status. `mismatched` lists same-id pairs whose normalized `text` or `required` differ, each entry holding only `expected` (the template-generated item) and `actual` (the checklist item), both normalized to the same four fields. `unexpected` lists checklist items whose id no applicable template item declares, again with only those four fields. `missing` and `mismatched` follow template order, `unexpected` follows checklist order. `ready` is true only when the checklist satisfies the existing readiness rule and every applicable required template item has a counterpart whose `id`, `text` and `required` match and whose status is `done`; differences in optional template items never affect readiness. An invalid version, unknown release, version mismatch, invalid checklist, template or store content, an empty filtered selection or a selection without any required item raises `ValueError`, and read failures raise `OSError`; the CLI reports these, plus non-UTF-8 or malformed JSON files and duplicate JSON object keys (whole-file rejection, as everywhere), as a single-line `error` object with exit 2, while a valid audit prints its report with exit 0 regardless of readiness. A missing store is treated as empty and then reports the version as unknown, and neither success nor failure modifies the store, the input files or the passed payloads, or creates any file or directory.

`ReleaseDesk.release_record(version, checklist, template, rollback)` freezes a release's changes, audit report and rollback plan into one read-only snapshot, and `python3 release_desk.py record-release 1.2.0 checklist.json template.json rollback.json` builds it from three UTF-8 JSON files using the same `--store` selection. The checklist and template follow the existing rules and the audit runs exactly like `audit_checklist`, including the category filter, id matching and the rule that optional template items never block readiness; when the resulting report is not `ready`, `ValueError` is raised and no new optional-item blocking is introduced. The rollback value must be an object holding exactly `targetVersion` and `steps`. `targetVersion` is either null or a registered version numerically smaller than the release version; an invalid, unknown or not-smaller value raises `ValueError`. `steps` is a non-empty array of single-line strings, each non-empty after trimming surrounding whitespace and rejected when the raw value contains a carriage return or newline; trimmed steps keep their array order and any duplicates.

def generate_checklist_with_dependencies(self, version, payload, dependencies):
        # Read-only dependency-aware checklist generation: the template is
        # filtered by the release's change categories exactly like
        # generate_checklist, then every direct and indirect prerequisite of
        # the selected items is added even when its own categories do not
        # apply. The whole dependency graph is validated against the whole
        # template first, so edges of template items the filter would drop
        # still have to be legal and acyclic. Nothing is written and the
        # passed objects are never mutated.
        if not isinstance(version, str) or not re.fullmatch(VERSION_PATTERN, version):
            raise ValueError("version must have three nonnegative numeric components")
        items = self._validated_template(payload)
        # Every id in the dependency map, at either end, must reference a
        # template item: the complete map and the complete template are
        # validated, including items the category filter never selects.
        prerequisites = self._validated_dependencies(
            dependencies, {item["id"] for item in items})
        # The whole store is validated before the version is looked up.
        records = self._read_store()
        if version not in records:
            raise ValueError("unknown release")
        selected = self._applicable_template_items(items, records[version])
        selected_ids = {item["id"] for item in selected}
        # Close over every direct and indirect prerequisite of the selected
        # items; shared prerequisites are collected once. Only the member set
        # matters here: the final order always follows the template.
        closure = set(selected_ids)
        pending = list(selected_ids)
        while pending:
            node = pending.pop()
            for prerequisite in prerequisites.get(node, ()):
                if prerequisite not in closure:
                    closure.add(prerequisite)
                    pending.append(prerequisite)
        selected_by_id = {item["id"]: item for item in selected}
        # Final items keep template order: initially selected items stay in
        # their positions and prerequisites added solely for the closure slot
        # in at their template positions, even when their categories do not
        # apply. The selected dicts already carry the uniform pending item
        # shape; added prerequisites are rendered from their template entry.
        result_items, dependency_pairs = [], []
        for item in items:
            item_id = item["id"]
            if item_id not in closure:
                continue
            if item_id in selected_ids:
                result_items.append(dict(selected_by_id[item_id]))
            else:
                result_items.append({"id": item_id, "text": item["text"],
                                     "required": item["required"], "status": "pending"})
            # Every final id gets a normalized array in template order;
            # omitted items and declared empty arrays both freeze to [].
            dependency_pairs.append((item_id, list(prerequisites.get(item_id, ()))))
        # includedPrerequisites lists, in template order, only the items
        # added solely because of a dependency edge.
        included_prerequisites = [item["id"] for item in items
                                  if item["id"] in closure and item["id"] not in selected_ids]
        return {"version": version, "items": result_items,
                "dependencies": dict(dependency_pairs),
                "includedPrerequisites": included_prerequisites}

    def audit_checklist(self, version, checklist, template):
        # Read-only audit of a declared checklist against the template items
        # applicable to the same release; status is never inferred from texts.
        if not isinstance(version, str) or not re.fullmatch(VERSION_PATTERN, version):
            raise ValueError("version must have three nonnegative numeric components")
        items = self._validated_checklist(checklist, version)
        template_items = self._validated_template(template)
        # The whole store is validated before the version is looked up.
        records = self._read_store()
        if version not in records:
